question.problem:
| $f$ | $Y=0$ | $Y=2$ | $Y=4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=0$ | $0.2$ | $0.1$ | $0.05$ |
| $X=1$ | $0$ | $0.25$ | $0.1$ |
| $X=2$ | $0.15$ | $0.1$ | $0.05$ |

Compute $P(0\le X<2\,|\,Y=4)$ given that the discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above.
question.worked_solution:
By the multiplication law for conditional probability, the required conditional probability is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}P(0\le X<2\,|\,Y=4) & =\frac{P((0\le X<2),Y=4)}{P(Y=4)} \\  & =\frac{P(X=0,Y=4)+P(X=1,Y=4)}{P(Y=4)} \\  & =\frac{f(0,4)+f(1,4)}{{f}_{Y}(4)},\end{aligned}
$$

where $f(x,y)$ is the joint probability mass function of $X$ and $Y,$ and ${f}_{Y}(y)$ is the marginal distribution of $Y.$

Recall that the marginal distribution for $Y$ corresponds to the column totals. Thus,

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y}(4) & =f(0,4)+f(1,4)+f(2,4) \\  & =0.05+0.1+0.05 \\  & =0.2.\end{aligned}
$$

From the given table, we have that $f(0,4)=0.05$ and $f(1,4)=0.1.$ 

Finally, substituting our values into our formula above, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}P(0\le X<2\,|\,Y=4) & =\frac{f(0,4)+f(1,4)}{{f}_{Y}(4)} \\  & =\frac{0.05+0.1}{0.2} \\  & =\frac{0.15}{0.2} \\  & =0.75.\end{aligned}
$$
